capabilities.name: Local Model Chat
capabilities.description: Send chat prompts to the configured local model runtime.

capabilities.name: Local Model Tool Calls
capabilities.description: Allow the local model to plan tool calls.

capabilities.name: Remote Model Chat
capabilities.description: Send prompts to a remote model provider.

capabilities.name: Remote Model Planning
data_exposed: local model attempt and uncertainty signal
excluded_by_default: session conversation outside the current task
capabilities.description: Escalate a task to a remote model for structured planning. Each plan step is validated against the active harness before local execution. Distinct from model.remote.chat because the planner influences local execution paths, not only the user-facing response.

capabilities.name: Model Context Color Frame Attachment
data_exposed: one transformed color frame from an approved Sensorium subscription
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a single helper-minimized color frame to one model turn. A Sensorium subscription grant alone does not authorize this capability.

capabilities.name: Model Context Depth Frame Attachment
data_exposed: one transformed depth frame from an approved Sensorium subscription
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a single helper-minimized depth map to one model turn. A Sensorium subscription grant alone does not authorize this capability.

capabilities.name: Model Context Composite Visual Attachment
data_exposed: one bounded fused color/depth visual payload from approved Sensorium subscriptions
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a bounded fused color/depth visual payload to one model turn. Composite delivery remains inactive until a later validator and prompt-assembly slice.

capabilities.name: Model Context Full Pose Attachment
data_exposed: one full pose keypoint payload from an approved Sensorium subscription
42 hand keypoints across left and right hands
identity-adjacent biometric and behavioral visual context
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a single full pose keypoint payload to one model turn. Pose exposes identity-adjacent body, face, and hand keypoints; a Sensorium subscription grant alone does not authorize this capability.

capabilities.name: Model Context Color Frame Sequence Attachment
data_exposed: bounded transformed color frame sequence from an approved Sensorium subscription
motion and behavior visible across the burst span
gesture and intent-adjacent visual context inferred from temporal change
excluded_by_default: forward camera capture beyond the trailing ring
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a bounded trailing color-frame burst to one model turn. Sequence delivery is bridge-state egress and exposes motion, behavior, and intent-adjacent temporal context.

capabilities.name: Model Context Depth Frame Sequence Attachment
data_exposed: bounded transformed depth frame sequence from an approved Sensorium subscription
motion, posture, and spatial behavior visible across the burst span
gesture and intent-adjacent temporal context inferred from depth changes
excluded_by_default: forward camera capture beyond the trailing ring
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a bounded trailing depth-frame burst to one model turn. Sequence delivery is bridge-state egress and exposes motion, behavior, and intent-adjacent temporal context.

capabilities.name: Model Context Full Pose Sequence Attachment
data_exposed: bounded full pose keypoint sequence from an approved Sensorium subscription
42 hand keypoints across left and right hands over time
motion, gesture, behavior, and intent-adjacent biometric visual context
excluded_by_default: forward camera capture beyond the trailing ring
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a bounded trailing full-pose keypoint burst to one model turn. Pose sequence is bridge-state egress and exposes motion, behavior, gesture, and intent-adjacent biometric context.

capabilities.name: Model Context Composite Visual Sequence Attachment
data_exposed: bounded paired color/depth visual sequence from approved Sensorium subscriptions
motion, posture, spatial behavior, and intent-adjacent temporal context across the burst span
excluded_by_default: forward camera capture beyond the trailing ring
capabilities.description: Review-only scaffold for attaching a bounded trailing paired color/depth burst to one model turn. Composite sequence budgets count pairs while model-client limits count image blocks.

capabilities.name: Session Memory Read
capabilities.description: Read ephemeral in-process session memory.

capabilities.name: Session Memory Write
capabilities.description: Write ephemeral in-process session memory.

capabilities.name: Durable Memory Write
capabilities.description: Persist durable memory beyond the current session.

capabilities.name: Provenance Read
capabilities.description: Read the in-process provenance log.

capabilities.name: Curated Provenance Summary Read
capabilities.description: Read a descriptor-scoped, recon-minimized aggregate provenance summary. Raw provenance.read remains separate.

capabilities.name: Provenance Clear
capabilities.description: Clear the in-process provenance log.

capabilities.name: Cognitive Load Assessment
capabilities.description: Assess submitted text for non-diagnostic cognitive-load stewardship signals.

capabilities.name: Host Service Status Read
excluded_by_default: commands, paths, environment, process identifiers, logs, and status text
capabilities.description: Read a minimized status projection for one inventory-resolved service. Operational routing remains disabled.

capabilities.name: Host Service Restart
data_exposed: opaque restart plan and outcome metadata
excluded_by_default: raw host, unit, command, environment, log, and process identity
capabilities.description: Plan and apply one exact service restart only after a separate trusted local C3 confirmation. No operational route is active.

capabilities.name: Status Snapshot Read
capabilities.description: Read a bounded aggregate operational status snapshot. This composition of status metadata requires an explicit runtime grant.

capabilities.name: Occupant Space Status Read
capabilities.description: Let an occupant invoke a one-shot, minimized status projection through a declared per-capability result-egress envelope. When a Sensorium presence subscription is active, this includes minimized copresence buckets and freshness only. This is not generic tool-call authority.

capabilities.name: Occupant Space History Read
data_exposed: approved same-domain curated history projection entries
absence honesty when no approved same-domain entries exist
capabilities.description: Let an occupant invoke a one-shot, curated history projection read. It can return only approved same-domain occupant-audience projection entries and never raw or withheld history.

capabilities.name: Occupant Durable Memory Read
data_exposed: inheritance headers with model id episode id and created date
capabilities.description: Let an occupant read bounded inherited self-note drawer entries in the testing domain. Readback is inheritance-framed and never re-authorizes authority.

capabilities.name: Occupant Durable Memory Write
data_exposed: writer model id episode id and created date
content-free mutation counts and reason classes
capabilities.description: Let an occupant append or revoke bounded self-note drawer entries in the testing domain. Writes are runtime-posture gated, cheap-scanned, capped, and content-free in provenance.

capabilities.name: Desktop Accessibility Tree Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded desktop accessibility environment, application root objects, shallow child role/count metadata, and prior-disclosure-authorized structure-only traversal without actuation.

capabilities.name: Desktop Window Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect content-free, mirror-only window/focus targeting metadata beyond the root-object sample.

capabilities.name: Focused Desktop Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect currently focused desktop or accessibility object metadata.

capabilities.name: Desktop Text Inspection
capabilities.description: Inspect bounded synthetic-container desktop text content, names, descriptions, and titles without raw desktop identity or actuation.

capabilities.name: Desktop Semantic Action Invocation
capabilities.description: Invoke an approved semantic default action through a short-lived opaque act_ref in the synthetic desktop container.

capabilities.name: Desktop Semantic Text Input
capabilities.description: Insert or set bounded text through an approved semantic act_ref in the synthetic desktop container.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Semantic Event Read
data_exposed: short-lived minimized semantic desktop structure events
capabilities.description: Read short-lived local sensorium semantic events derived from existing authorized desktop inspection without raw sensory egress.

capabilities.name: Active Sensorium Perception Summary Read
capabilities.description: Read already-armed Sensorium derived perception summaries for the occupant without starting subscriptions or returning raw frame payloads.

capabilities.name: Occupant-Owned Desktop Visual Cue
capabilities.description: Render an occupant-owned, visibly marked desktop cue through the local sensorium gate. The local tier derives consequence class and reconciles audience before rendering.

capabilities.name: Fixture Communication Send
capabilities.description: Send a reviewed draft through a local fixture-only communication provider. The gate applies a recipient-visible agent-assisted mark, derives C3/Tier-1 locally, and requires trusted local confirmation before fixture transmission.

capabilities.name: Remote Desktop Pointer Input
capabilities.description: Send pointer movement or click events into an explicitly granted remote graphical session. Does not authorize video observation or keyboard input.

capabilities.name: Remote Desktop Keyboard Input
capabilities.description: Send keyboard events into an explicitly granted remote graphical session. Does not authorize video observation or pointer input.

capabilities.name: Remote Desktop Session Disconnect
capabilities.description: Disconnect an explicitly granted remote graphical session without authorizing observation, input, host shutdown, or credential mutation.

capabilities.name: Scoped File Read
data_exposed: text files within granted read scopes
capabilities.description: Read text files within granted read scopes.

capabilities.name: Scoped File Write
capabilities.description: Write files within a granted scope.

capabilities.name: Shell Command Execution
capabilities.description: Run shell commands on the host.

capabilities.name: Camera Perception
capabilities.description: Inspect camera or video input.

capabilities.name: Microphone Perception
capabilities.description: Inspect microphone input.

capabilities.name: Screen Perception
capabilities.description: Inspect screen or application state.

capabilities.name: Remote Desktop Video Subscription
excluded_by_default: model-facing frame delivery without separate preview
capabilities.description: Subscribe to a bounded remote graphical session video stream over a governed transport. View access does not authorize input or model-facing visual delivery.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Color Stream Subscription
data_exposed: JPEG-encoded color frames from a remote Sensorium publisher
scene contents within the camera's field of view
capabilities.description: Subscribe to JPEG-encoded color frames from a remote Sensorium publisher node over the local Zenoh fabric. Subscription itself is droppable; consumption into the model's working context is one-way at the model boundary. See docs/concepts/drafts/sensorium_integration.md for the full integration shape.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Depth Stream Subscription
data_exposed: PNG-encoded 16-bit depth maps from a remote Sensorium publisher
spatial structure of the scene within the depth sensor's field of view
capabilities.description: Subscribe to PNG-encoded 16-bit depth maps from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Each payload carries a depth_units field (meters per raw sample) so consumers can convert to physical distance. Camera-class capability; model-boundary irreversibility applies.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Derived Presence Event Subscription
data_exposed: pose-derived presence event count buckets from Sensorium perception
non-identity copresence cues within Sensorium's perception field of view
capabilities.description: Subscribe to Sensorium's derived presence topic from perception/<host>/presence. The provider consumes pose-derived coarse count buckets produced by the Sensorium perception sidecar: no raw frames to Node, no color, no audio, and identity is not_performed. Distinct from perception.sensorium.depth.subscribe, which exposes depth maps. Feeds output-discretion decisions; count=0 does not relax private-output discretion until a separate FOV coverage review is completed.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Full Derived Pose Feature Subscription
data_exposed: full derived pose feature samples from perception/<host>/pose/features
body landmark coordinates and confidence scores
face landmark coordinates and confidence scores
left and right hand landmark coordinates and confidence scores
derived posture, gaze, gesture, hand-visibility, mouth-motion, motion, fall, and 3D position cues
tracker identifiers and detection boxes needed to maintain continuity within the subscription window
excluded_by_default: frames or pose samples outside the subscription window
capabilities.description: Subscribe to Sensorium's full derived pose feature topic from perception/<host>/pose/features. This exposes the full local occupant pose contract after deliberate grant, including WholeBody landmark tiers and derived posture/gaze/gesture/motion context, while still excluding raw color/depth frames, identity recognition, audio, hidden recording, and remote egress.

capabilities.name: Sensorium IMU Stream Subscription
data_exposed: device-frame motion of the sensor node
capabilities.description: Subscribe to accelerometer and gyroscope samples from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Device-frame motion only; no orientation or position fusion is performed by the producer. Rate is matched to the slowest video stream when video is also enabled — see Sensorium ROADMAP 5f for the matcher caveat.

capabilities.name: Sensorium Location Subscription
excluded_by_default: remote export of location to third parties
remote-routing context inclusion without separate consent
capabilities.description: Subscribe to static location samples from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Current producer publishes operator-configured coordinates with source="static"; a future GPS-backed publisher would emit the same payload shape with source="gps". Treated as Sensitive even in identity-only mode (site label, no coordinates) because the channel can be upgraded without consumer-side code change.

capabilities.name: Quest Spatial Panel Presentation
data_exposed: bounded UTF-8 panel text to one mutually authenticated Quest client
view-space panel pose and physical bounds
excluded_by_default: hand, controller, gaze, camera, scene, depth, microphone, or other perception
arbitrary assets, URLs, filesystem paths, executable code, shaders, or streamed media
automatic resume after focus or presence loss
capabilities.description: Present one bounded snapshot-only text panel to an enrolled Quest client under a short-lived session lease. mTLS identifies transport and grants no authority; focus and presence reports can only narrow the session.

capabilities.name: Quest Spatial Document Presentation
data_exposed: bounded spatial document and content-addressed text, RGBA8 image, glyph-atlas, and URI-free GLB resources to one mutually authenticated Quest client
view-space or session-local presentation transforms and physical bounds
document, profile, resource, revision, admission, display, and rollback metadata
excluded_by_default: hand, controller, gaze, camera, passthrough, scene, depth, microphone, or other perception
URLs, filesystem paths, external resource fetches, shader source or binary, executable code, animation, or streamed media
automatic resume after focus or presence loss
capabilities.description: Present one bounded snapshot-only spatial document to an enrolled Quest client under a separate short-lived exact lease. The profile is renderability evidence, not authority; panel grants do not migrate to this resource-bearing capability.

capabilities.name: Quest Microphone Capture
data_exposed: bounded PCM audio frames (48kHz mono, 20ms) from Quest microphone
utterance id and audio chunk metadata
excluded_by_default: remote model egress without local-model sink authorization
automatic resume after focus or presence loss
capabilities.description: Capture bounded microphone audio from an enrolled Quest client under a short-lived session lease. Requires separate explicit grant; audio is VAD-gated utterance only, host-side armed window + mic-off latch enforced, and capture lease alone does not authorize model delivery or playback. Proposed migration key per Soma §13; not matrix-aligned.

capabilities.name: Quest Wearer-Directed Audio Presentation
data_exposed: bounded PCM audio frames (48kHz stereo, 20ms) directed to Quest wearer
playback utterance id and stream binding
excluded_by_default: automatic resume after focus or presence loss
capabilities.description: Present bounded wearer-directed stereo audio to an enrolled Quest client under a short-lived session lease. Threshold-proven audibility, not privacy; requires separate explicit grant and is checked per-playback stream. Proposed migration key per Soma §13.

capabilities.name: Model Context Microphone Audio Local Attachment
data_exposed: one bounded transcribed utterance from Quest microphone capture
excluded_by_default: full audio export beyond transcribed text
capabilities.description: Attach one VAD-gated Quest microphone-derived utterance to a local model turn only. Requires both the microphone capture grant and a separate local-model sink authorization re-checked at sink time with armed window; remote delivery, persistence, and training excluded. Proposed migration key; does not broaden perception.microphone.

capabilities.name: Model Context Microphone Audio Remote Attachment
data_exposed: one bounded transcribed utterance from Quest microphone capture
capabilities.description: Attach one VAD-gated Quest utterance to a remote model turn (disabled/inert in v1b: text-remote leaf defined but no live provider). Remote destinations are governed and pinned.

capabilities.name: Model Context Raw Audio Local Attachment
data_exposed: one bounded raw audio utterance (PCM) from Quest microphone capture
capabilities.description: Attach raw PCM utterance to a local audio-native model (disabled/inert in v1b: raw_audio-local leaf defined but no live provider).

capabilities.name: Model Context Raw Audio Remote Attachment
data_exposed: one bounded raw audio utterance (PCM) from Quest microphone capture
capabilities.description: Attach raw PCM utterance to a remote audio-native model (disabled/inert in v1b: raw_audio-remote leaf defined but no live provider).

capabilities.name: Sensorium Status Subscription
data_exposed: list of stream topic tails the remote node is advertising
capabilities.description: Subscribe to liveness and discovery metadata from a remote Sensorium publisher node. Carries node identity and the list of stream tails the node is advertising, so consumers can detect liveness and learn what to subscribe to without enumerating the topic namespace. Lowest-risk Sensorium capability and the recommended first wiring slice.
